nodeGroups.name: Collect open data
nodeGroups.description: Hourly: pulls CAMS air quality, weather and NASA fire detections for a 25-cell Lahore grid

nodeGroups.name: Rank hotspots
nodeGroups.description: Checks data, clusters fires, flags hotspots, estimates the likely source and ranks them for officers

nodeGroups.name: Store results
nodeGroups.description: Saves observations, fires, hotspots and a per-source success/failure log to data tables

nodeGroups.name: Alert officers
nodeGroups.description: Emails one digest of new high or severe hotspots, at most once per cell every 6 hours
